mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_LIST ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, TOTAL_PROD_PRICE, SHIPPING_FEE, FINAL_PRICE, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_DATE, RECEIVER_NAME, RECEIVER_ADDR, RECEIVER_TEL ) VALUES ( #{orderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalProdPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{shippingFee, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{finalPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{orderStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{receiverName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receiverAddr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{receiverTel, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM ( ITEM_ID, ORDER_ID, PROD_ID, QUANTITY, PRICE ) VALUES ( SEQ_ORDER_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL, #{orderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prodId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{quantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{price, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )

INSERT INTO PAYMENT_DETAIL ( IMP_UID, ORDER_ID, PAY_METHOD, PAID_AMOUNT, PG_PROVIDER, PAID_AT, RECEIPT_URL ) VALUES ( #{impUid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paidAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pgProvider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paidAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{receiptUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS "orderNo", O.ORDER_DATE AS "orderDate", CASE WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID' THEN '결제완료' WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN '결제대기' WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN '결제실패' WHEN O.ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' THEN '주문취소' ELSE O.ORDER_STATUS END AS "status", O.ORDER_STATUS AS "orderStatus", O.FINAL_PRICE AS "totalAmount", P.PROD_NAME AS "productName", (P.IMAGE_URL || P.FILE_NAME) AS "productImg", OI.QUANTITY AS "quantity" FROM ORDER_LIST O JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, PROD_ID, QUANTITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ORDER_ID ORDER BY ITEM_ID) as RN FROM ORDER_ITEM ) OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID AND OI.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MASTER P ON OI.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} AND O.ORDER_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -#{period}) ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC
